caption: The drawing depicts a large, brown, ceramic jug with a narrow neck and a small, slightly flared rim, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The jug features blue decorative motifs on its upper half, including stylized floral or leaf shapes both above and below an inscription. The inscription, rendered in blue, reads: "CROLIUS MANHATTAN-WELLS NEW-YORK." At the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, detailed rendering of the jug’s handle and rim in a similar color palette of browns and blues, showing a partial view of the handle, neck, and accented areas. The name “Yolande DeLasser” appears in small letters at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
